error_reason: The Planner hallucinated complex ecological dynamics (insect preying on fish eggs, competition with juveniles) that were not present in the problem statement. Consequently, the Planner incorrectly concluded that stopping the pesticide would cause fish populations to decrease (Option C) rather than increase due to the restoration of their primary food supply (Option A). This fundamental misinterpretation of the causal relationship was the decisive error.
